proposal.hypothesis: The selected scalar parent measured 0.45303 s. A guarded SIMD candidate without a width clause measured 0.08088 s, while the recorded simdlen(4) candidate measured 0.14358 s. This candidate tests whether an eight-lane OpenMP SIMD hint changes lowering favorably. It retains a zero-based contiguous x loop from row bases that include x0, uses no alignment clause or ISA assumption, and keeps the same compiler-vectorizable loop when the OpenMP SIMD guard is unavailable. Performance remains to be measured.

retained: Keep the timestep kernel unfused and preserve its existing spatial bounds, arithmetic grouping, buffer parity, and interface.
Form each row pointer at the interior start x0 and traverse with a zero-based x index for width x1 - x0, applying the interior offset once.
Guard an explicit OpenMP simdlen(8) directive for OpenMP 4.0 or later; the same canonical loop remains available for compiler vectorization when the guard is absent.
Use no aligned clause because the actual line starts include the interior offset and alignment is not guaranteed.
Do not change compiler flags, threading, or spatial or temporal blocking.
